Cricket Final Sees Upset as Low-Scoring Team Wins Trophy

In a historic T20 Global Super League 2026 final, the Guyana Amazon Warriors were bowled out for 85 runs. Despite this low score, they went on to defeat the San Francisco Unicorns, who were all out for 79 runs. The Guyana Amazon Warriors secured the trophy in what is described as a significant upset in cricket history.
